The search is added. Since the app is served as static files, just **reload http://maker:4001** and your saved links will still be there.

**Flow 2 — finding a link (please try this now):**
You'll now see a **search box** just above your list. Type part of a word into it — for example type `food` (matching one of the example links), or a word from the link you saved earlier. Watch the list narrow down as you type.

A few choices I made on my own that I'd like your judgement on:

- **I set the search to look across everything at once — the title, the link address, and the topic** — so one box finds a match wherever the word appears. Please check whether searching everything together is what you'd want, or whether you'd expect to search only titles, say.
- **I set results to filter live as you type**, rather than needing you to press Enter or a button. See whether that feels right.
- **I set the matching part of each result to be highlighted**, and show a small "N links found" count, so you can see why something matched.

Please try searching for a word — then tell me: when you search the way you naturally would, does the right link surface, and does this feel like it meets your "I can always find it again" goal?
